    Loop-free finite covers #

    A ray category is loop-free when every nonzero endomorphism has trivial homotopy class. A finite connected chain-bounded ray category with cancellation has a free fundamental group (isFreeGroup_end_fund), free groups are residually finite (FreeRF.exists_finite_quotient), so some finite quotient φ of π₁(P, x₀) is nontrivial on the finitely many nontrivial classes of nonzero endomorphisms. The Galois cover for the voltage f ↦ φ([ℓ_y f ℓ_z⁻¹])⁻¹ is then a finite loop-free ray category (exists_loopFree_gcover).
